top_signals.title: Lula and Bolsonaro in tight race as Brazil prepares to vote
top_signals.summary: The race will determine whether Brazil joins a regional rightward shift that has seen conservative allies of the U.S. President win in Chile, Colombia and Peru.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
